title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
summary: The consumer-focused blockchain will close Dec. 15 after Igloo spent tens of millions supporting it, days after Blast said its own network was no longer worth operating.

title: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
summary: The new standard is aimed at regulated stablecoins, funds and bonds whose issuers need identity checks, sanctions controls and other transfer rules built into the asset itself.

title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
summary: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

title: Peter Thiel-backed Founders Fund leads a $5 million token buy in crypto collateral protocol Anvil
summary: Pantera Capital and Bullish also participated in the ANVL purchase as Anvil rolls out software designed to make its collateral protocol easier for businesses to integrate.

title: Crypto is expanding the boundaries of what can be priced
summary: The future of crypto may therefore depend less on creating the next novel asset and more on building the infrastructure required to price a growing universe of existing ones, argues Altius co-founder and CEO Annabelle Huang.

title: OKX draws investment from StanChart, Circle, Ripple as it pushes beyond crypto exchange roots
summary: The exchange is increasingly aiming to position itself as a global financial tech platform spanning crypto, payments and tokenized assets, following an investment and joint venture with NYSE parent ICE.

title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
summary: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

title: Self-styled 'Godfather' gets 6 years in prison for $37 million Meta fraud scheme
summary: Adam Iza’s sentence runs concurrently with a 15-year term imposed last month for his role in an attempted bitcoin robbery.

title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
summary: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.

title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
summary: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.

title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
summary: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.

title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
summary: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.

title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
summary: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.

title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
summary: The DIGIT pilot will test distributed ledger technology and onchain settlement for UK sovereign debt, with issuance expected by the first quarter of 2027.

title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
summary: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
summary: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.

title: Google Launches Nano Banana 2.1: Better Than Its Predecessor at Half the Price
summary: Google's new image model, Nano Banana 2.1, is live. It costs about half as much as its predecessor, but the performance claims come from Google's own tests.

title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
summary: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.

title: Someone Scraped 5.6 Billion TikTok Videos and Put the Data on Hugging Face for Free
summary: A developer posted metadata for about 5.6 billion public TikTok videos, scraped through the app's private API in a way TikTok's terms prohibit. The free dataset also doubles as a storefront.

title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
summary: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
summary: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.

title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
summary: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
summary: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under "WINK" with Gemini as custodian, and add the Winklevoss twins to a wave of institutional interest in the privacy coin.

title: Mistral AI Drops 'Le Chonk': A Massive AI Model Named After a Cat Meme
summary: Paris-based Mistral launched Large 4, a model nicknamed after a June internet joke. It tops GPT-6 Astra on one finance test, but trails Claude on others.

title: Bitcoin briefly slides below $84,000 as crypto long liquidations reach $487 million
summary: Crypto liquidations amounted to $555.6 million over the past 24 hours, including $487.2 million in long positions, according to CoinGlass.

title: Coinbase Pro to return; Deribit integration creates Coinbase Global Exchange
summary: Coinbase plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end and has completed its Deribit integration, creating Coinbase Global Exchange.

title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2 Abstract to shut down after losing ‘tens of millions’
summary: Abstract, the Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2, will shut down on Dec. 15. Users must bridge assets off before then.

title: Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze, says it has ‘no legal entitlement’ to funds
summary: Conduit is suing Tether in NY federal court, alleging the USDT issuer froze $2.76 million of its funds for over a year without explanation.

title: Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, proposed WINK ticker
summary: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot Zcash ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian and a 0.25% fee, rivaling Grayscale's ZCSH.

title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
summary: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

title: Polymarket rolls out V2 upgrade with single ERC-1155 positions contract, pUSD collateral
summary: Polymarket rolls out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis-based setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.
